validity.value: No more than six (6) months old at the time of application

expression_restriction.value: Facial expression must be neutral, not smiling, mouth must be closed

face_visibility.value: Full face view required; applicant must be facing the camera directly

ears_visibility.value: Hairline and ears must be visible

headwear_policy.value: Covering of the head is prohibited unless for medical or religious purposes; a formal written request must be submitted and approved by the Visa Office (evisaoffice@bahamas.gov.bs)

clothing_restriction.value: Applicant's clothing should be in color, with shoulders covered; clothing must not bear any form of military or civil servant badges or ornaments

accessories.value: Makeup should be neutral, jewelry should be modest; no selfies permitted

file_spec.value: JPEG, PNG, or BMP format; file size between 15KB and 7.5MB; pixel dimensions between 480x640 and 4800x6400

clothing.en: Clothing should be in color, with shoulders covered; must not bear any military or civil servant badges or ornaments
clothing.ko: 복장은 컬러(색상 있는 옷)로 착용하며 어깨가 가려지도록 해야 함. 군복이나 공무원 제복의 배지·장식은 금지
clothing.ja: 服装はカラー(色付きの服)を着用し、肩が隠れるようにすること。軍や公務員の記章・装飾品の着用は禁止

expression.en: Neutral facial expression, not smiling, mouth must be closed
expression.ko: 무표정(중립적 표정)을 유지해야 하며 미소는 금지, 입은 다문 상태를 유지
expression.ja: 無表情(中立的な表情)を保ち、笑顔は不可、口は閉じること

ears.en: Hairline and ears must be visible
ears.ja: 生え際と耳が見えること

face_visibility.en: Full face view required; applicant must be facing the camera directly
face_visibility.ko: 정면 전체 얼굴이 나와야 하며 카메라를 똑바로 응시해야 함
face_visibility.ja: 顔全体が正面から写っていること。カメラを真っ直ぐ見ること

headwear.en: Head covering is prohibited unless for medical or religious purposes, subject to a formal written request approved by the Visa Office
headwear.ko: 머리 가림은 의료 또는 종교적 목적을 제외하고 금지되며, 예외 시 비자사무국(Visa Office)에 서면 승인 요청이 필요
headwear.ja: 頭部の被り物は医療上または宗教上の理由を除き禁止。例外の場合はビザ局への書面申請と承認が必要

accessories.en: Makeup should be neutral, jewelry should be modest; no selfies
accessories.ko: 메이크업은 자연스럽게, 액세서리는 과하지 않게 착용. 셀카(셀프촬영) 사진 불가
accessories.ja: メイクは控えめに、アクセサリーは控えめなものを着用。自撮り写真は不可
